rooms.name: Malacca, 1400
rooms.description: A prince rests by the river. A mouse-deer kicks a hunting dog.
rooms.unlock_text: Starting room — the story begins here.

rooms.name: Merdeka Square, 1957
rooms.description: A voice echoes seven times. The crowd roars. A flag rises.
rooms.unlock_text: The kingdom was founded. The portal jumps forward 557 years.

rooms.name: AWS Malaysia, 2024
rooms.description: Servers spin up. A new region goes live. The cloud arrives.
rooms.unlock_text: Independence declared. Sixty-seven years later, the cloud lands.
